title: FIND FREQUENCY OF SURFACE LABELS
description: This command outputs a set of soft ROIs, one for each label in the input, where the value is how many of the input maps had that label at that vertex, divided by the number of input maps.

label_maps.description: label file containing individual label maps from many subjects

probability_metric_out.description: the relative frequencies of each label at each vertex

exclude_unlabeled.description: don't make a probability map of the unlabeled key
